day_shape: 78 items: Trump announces Board of Peace Gaza disarmament framework with Hamas, IDF detonates 700 tonnes of explosives on Beaufort Ridge tunnels, Treasury sanctions six Mahan Air/IRGC-linked entities across four countries, UK charges dual national with IRGC spying on RAF Cyprus base, and regime channels claim fresh drone strikes on Ali Al-Salem base in Kuwait.

threads.label: Gaza disarmament framework announced
threads.summary: Trump announced via Truth Social that the Board of Peace reached an agreement for the complete disarmament of Hamas and other armed groups in Gaza, with US and BoP officials calling it a breakthrough. Jerusalem Post reported IRGC officials urged Hamas delegates not to sign, while a Hamas official said the group will not implement it without Israeli endorsement; IRIB cited Al Jazeera on a weapons handover draft.

threads.label: IDF Beaufort Ridge tunnel demolition
threads.summary: Netanyahu and Katz announced in a joint statement that the IDF used 700 tonnes of explosives to demolish Hezbollah's tunnel system beneath Beaufort Ridge in southern Lebanon, with Upper Galilee residents pre-notified. Defa Press framed the operation as a ceasefire violation, and the IDF also reported dismantling weapons caches at Majdal Zoun.

threads.label: US sanctions and IRGC drone reward
threads.summary: The US Treasury and State Department sanctioned six entities and individuals in China, India, Russia and Iran supporting Mahan Air and the IRGC. Iran International reported a separate US reward of up to $15 million for information disrupting an IRGC drone-production company's finances.

threads.label: UK espionage charge over RAF Cyprus
threads.summary: London police announced the arrest in Cyprus of a dual British-Azerbaijani national accused of conducting hostile surveillance on a British air base for the IRGC. Iran International said it is the first overseas investigation under Britain's National Security Act.

threads.label: Regime claims on Kuwait, Iraq strikes
threads.summary: IRIB and Defa Press said the 27th phase of Army Operation Thunderbolt targeted Ali Al-Salem base in Kuwait with drones, citing Soar Atlas satellite imagery and a Wall Street Journal report of US force-posture review. Regime outlets also reported explosions in Dohuk and Erbil/Sulaimani, and Iraq's spokesman Haider Al-Abadi denied Trump's claim Baghdad was pre-notified of joint US-Saudi strikes.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz and US naval posture
threads.summary: CENTCOM said P-8 Poseidon aircraft are patrolling regional waters and that its blockade against Iran has redirected 24 commercial vessels, disabled two and boarded two, while rebutting three IRGC claims about the Strait as false. Defa Press cited Al Jazeera saying 70% of Middle East oil has no alternative to the Strait and claimed regional producers lost over $15bn in early weeks of war.

threads.label: Khamenei Arbaeen and domestic pressure
threads.summary: Khamenei's office posted messages on Arbaeen pilgrimage, jihad and resistance, and solicited donations for war-affected citizens, while IRIB and Defa Press covered pilgrim traffic and martyr funerals. Iran International reported political prisoners accusing authorities of using the war to escalate executions, and alleged security agents mutilated a slain protester's royalist tattoos.

events.title_en: Thales and Destinus collaborate on developing defence systems.
events.summary_en: Arms companies Thales and Destinus have signed a strategic partnership agreement to develop a new generation of air defence systems and offensive weapons. Under this agreement, Thales provides its key technologies in the fields of radar, air defence, artificial intelligence, warhead and industrial production to Destinus so that this company produces systems compliant with NATO standards and suitable for high-intensity combat. events.summary: Iranian security agents allegedly cut away skin bearing tattoos of Reza Shah and an imperial crown before killing a 21-year-old protester before later shooting him dead, according to sources close to his family.

events.title: Trump likely to expand strikes on Iran rather than withdraw, ex-Pentagon official says
events.summary: US President Donald Trump's most likely response to the conflict with Iran will be to intensify air strikes against a broader range of targets rather than withdraw or launch a ground invasion, former senior Pentagon official David Des Roches told Iran International TV.
